content:
A '''successful hit''' occurs during [[combat]] when an attack overcomes its target's [[Defence]].

This can be better explained by considering the following:

For every attack, there are two stages.
*Stage 1 ([[Damage per second/Melee#Step seven: Calculate the hit chance|accuracy roll]]): Roll the attacker's offensive bonuses against the target's defensive bonuses. If true, proceed to stage 2. If false, produce a 0 (splash for player [[Magic]] attacks). This is '''not''' a successful hit.
*Stage 2 ([[Damage per second/Melee#Step eight: Calculate the melee damage output|damage roll]]): Roll a hit ranging from 0 to the attacker's maximum hit. If the roll is from a player, then 0's are rounded up to 1's.
** Some monster special attacks have a minimum hit, such as [[General Graardor]]'s ranged attack that deals a minimum of 15 damage).{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/591321214771077120|date=23 April 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100173|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=Damage is a random number between 0 and your max hit, inclusive. Each possible value has an equal chance of being rolled.}}

A damaging spell cast by a player that hits a 0 which does not visibly splash is always a successful hit, and if it has additional effects (such as freezing for [[ice spells]] or chance to lower the target's [[Strength]] if [[Ahrim the Blighted's equipment|Ahrim's equipment]] is worn) they will occur as usual.

Some [[passive effect]]s only occur during successful hits - such as [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's]] and [[Karil the Tainted's equipment|Karil's equipment]] set effects, as well as the [[serpentine helm]] where there is a chance to [[venom|envenom]] the target.

Special attack effects also rely on a successful hit to activate; for example, godsword secondary effects require the attack to land. On a few occasions, the attack '''must''' deal damage alongside being a successful hit in order for the effect to activate, such as a [[dragon warhammer]]{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/869201558839406592|date=29 May 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109129|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=While special attacks usually do trigger on a successful roll even if the damage comes out as 0, the DWH blog said this one wouldn't.}} 

Some monsters may use AoE attacks as their standard attacks, which land as successful hits if the player is caught in them.

==Guaranteed hit==

There are circumstances in which damage from an attack is guaranteed, and will not hit a 0 or splash. 

===Equipment that guarantees damage===
The following is a list of weapons with a [[special attack]] that skips the accuracy roll and therefore guarantees damage. The minimum damage is 1 unless otherwise stated.

*[[Bone dagger]] (if the player wasn't the previous entity to hit the opponent)
*[[Dark bow]], dealing a minimum of 16 damage with [[dragon arrows]] and 10 with other arrows
*[[Dorgeshuun crossbow]] (if the player wasn't the previous entity to hit the opponent)
*[[Dragon warhammer]] (if the first hit on [[Tekton]])
*[[Elder maul]] (if the first hit on [[Tekton]])
*[[Granite hammer]], dealing a minimum of 5 damage
*[[Magic comp bow]]
*[[Magic longbow]]
*[[Seercull]]
*[[Voidwaker]], dealing a minimum of 50% of the user’s maximum melee hit
*Any melee weapons used within 10 ticks (6 seconds) after being under the effect of a [[soulflame horn]]'s special attack.

The following have [[passive effect]]s that skip the accuracy roll and guarantee at least 1 damage:

*[[Diamond bolts (e)]]/[[Diamond dragon bolts (e)]]
*[[Verac the Defiled's equipment]]

===List of monsters that inflict guaranteed hits===
This list only consists of monsters who land guaranteed hits as auto-attacks; mechanics are not included.

*[[Kalphite Queen]] (Ranged and Magic){{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/606032495704801281|date=3 June 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105949|archivedate=26 May 2020}}
*[[The Nightmare]]/[[Phosani's Nightmare]] (Melee)
*[[Thrower troll]]
*[[Ice troll female]]
*[[Duke Sucellus]] (shattering icicles, targeted AoE)
*[[Sol Heredit]] (auto-attacks, targeted AoE)
*[[Pestilent Bloat]] (Ranged)
*[[Sotetseg]] (Ranged and Magic)
*[[Verzik Vitur]] (Ranged)
*All monsters in the [[Fortis Colosseum]] (if Relentless 3 is active)

===Barbarian Assault===
In the [[Barbarian Assault]] [[minigames|minigame]], there is an [[Attacker]] role. Players who level up this role will always deal an extra amount of damage equal to the level of their role against monsters when assigned the Attacker role, making it impossible to hit 0.
